note: Port connectivity and freight network — documented connections between ports and transport assets. Every connection records the actual documented link (concession, SPV, completion announcement, parliament reply); geographic proximity alone is never treated as connectivity. Route geometry is not asserted where unavailable. The Comprehensive Port Connectivity Plan (CPCP) totals are programme-level aggregates held separately from the individual connections listed here.

cpcp_summary.text: DPIIT's 2022 Comprehensive Port Connectivity Plan assessment led MoPSW with MoRTH and the Ministry of Railways to identify 294 rail and road port-connectivity projects: 84 completed (63 rail, 21 road), 66 under implementation (27 rail, 39 road), 144 under planning (42 rail, 102 road). Within port limits the port authorities execute; beyond port limits the railways, MoRTH or state governments do.

gatishakti_layers.text: 26 data layers with relevant attributes of all operational ports are mapped on the GIS-based PM GatiShakti National Master Plan portal.
